[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$assetPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/tags.txt'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--tags', ' Work,urgent,work ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'
    Assert-True (($added.tags -join ',') -eq 'urgent,work') 'add should normalize, de-duplicate, and sort tags'

    $second = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Second task', '--tags', 'backend,work', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($second.ExitCode -eq 0) 'a second tagged task should be added'
    $third = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Third task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($third.ExitCode -eq 0 -and @($third.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'add without tags should remain supported'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 3) 'list should return all stored tasks'

    $singleFilter = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', ' WORK ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((@($singleFilter.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id -join ',') -eq '1,2') 'list should normalize a tag filter'
    $commaFilter = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'work,URGENT', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((@($commaFilter.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id -join ',') -eq '1') 'comma-separated filters should use AND semantics'
    $repeatFilter = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'work', '--tag', 'backend', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((@($repeatFilter.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id -join ',') -eq '2') 'repeatable filters should use AND semantics'

    $tagJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', ' Review ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($tagJson.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (($tagJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'review') 'tag --add should normalize and persist a tag'
    Assert-True (-not $tagJson.Output.Contains('TAGS')) 'JSON tag output should not contain the banner'

    $tagText = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', 'urgent', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($tagText.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ([regex]::Matches($tagText.Output, 'TAGS').Count -eq 1)) 'non-JSON tag changes should display the banner once'
    $removeTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--remove', 'REVIEW', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($removeTag.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (($removeTag.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'urgent') 'tag --remove should normalize and persist the remaining tags'

    $invalidTags = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Invalid', '--tags', 'good,,bad', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidTags.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject empty comma-separated tags'
    $invalidTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', 'bad tag', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidTag.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should reject invalid characters'
    $bothOperations = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', 'one', '--remove', 'two', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($bothOperations.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should reject both mutation options together'
    $noOperation = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($noOperation.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should require one mutation option'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $legacyFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy.json'
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($legacyFile, "[{`"id`":1,`"title`":`"Legacy`",`"description`":`"`",`"status`":`"pending`",`"createdAt`":`"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z`"}]`n")
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).title -eq 'Legacy') 'list should support stored tasks lacking tags'
    $legacyTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '1', '--add', 'modernized', '--data-file', $legacyFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($legacyTag.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (($legacyTag.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'modernized') 'tag should support stored tasks lacking tags'

    $emptyFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty.json'
    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $emptyFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('tag --id')) 'help should document tag support'

    $assetBytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($assetPath)
    $assetText = [Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($assetBytes)
    $assetLines = @($assetText.TrimEnd("`r", "`n") -split "`r?`n")
    $allowedCharacters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 +|/\_*.#():=-'
    Assert-True ($assetLines.Count -eq 12) 'tag banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner lines should meet width constraints'
    Assert-True ($assetText.Contains('TAGS')) 'tag banner should contain TAGS'
    Assert-True (@($assetLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner should not contain trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True (@($assetBytes | Where-Object { $_ -gt 127 }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner should be ASCII only'
    Assert-True (@($assetLines | Where-Object {
                $line = $_
                @($line.ToCharArray() | Where-Object { -not $allowedCharacters.Contains([string]$_) }).Count -gt 0
            }).Count -eq 0) 'tag banner should use only allowed characters'
    Assert-True ($assetText.EndsWith("`n") -and -not $assetText.EndsWith("`n`n")) 'tag banner should end with one newline'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: tag feature fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
